nodes.label: Shell Capability Bridge Contract
nodes.rationale: Frozen for M5. Defines window.shell ABI, envelope, capabilities (auth, boot, filesystem, notifications), server manifest endpoint, loopback origin, failed-boot/auto-revert state machine. Authoritative contract between Dart and JavaScript sides.

nodes.label: M5 Build Contracts (Flutter Shell)
nodes.rationale: Defines four builder areas (shell-bridge, shell-updater, server-bundle, web-shim), ownership, frozen signatures, dependencies, environment notes. Scaffold for parallel M5 work.

nodes.label: M5 On-Device Acceptance Script
nodes.rationale: Manual test script for M5 acceptance criteria that cannot be verified by host tests: soft-keyboard editing, offline boot, OTA update, revert, scheduled notifications with app closed, filesystem dialogs. Requires physical device.

nodes.label: Shared Rust parsing and query core
nodes.norm_label: shared rust parsing and query core

nodes.label: E2E Test Suite
nodes.rationale: M3 end-to-end test suite covering user journeys, safe mode, browsing behaviors, acceptance criteria, polish, frontmatter, list alignment, and folder tree operations

nodes.label: Plugin Registry
nodes.rationale: Serves base distribution plus extra-task-states plugin to test marker semantics and safe mode scenarios

nodes.label: Import Map Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Inline is the only option because browsers never shipped external import maps, and it must come before the app module because a map is only consulted for resolutions that happen after it is inserted

nodes.label: Flutter Shell README
nodes.rationale: Overview of the Android shell: webview, OTA updater, bearer token auth, capability bridge. Points to BRIDGE.md, CONTRACTS.md, TESTPLAN.md. Documents build setup, APK building, launch flow, M5 status (code-complete, APK builds, hardware verification pending).

nodes.label: Filter DSL
nodes.rationale: Custom filter language (not Mongo's) with same-type comparisons, explicit contains/any, missing vs null distinction, and explicit date type. Evaluated identically on client and server.

nodes.label: Shared Core (life-manager-core)
nodes.rationale: The shared parsing/filter crate that compiles to both native (server) and wasm32 (client kernel), ensuring identical behavior. Covers document parsing, YAML subset, dates, filter DSL, and splices.

nodes.label: Splice Helpers
nodes.rationale: Line-based edit computation for frontmatter and machine sections, never parsing and re-serializing blocks. Preserves comments and formatting, supports concurrent edits.

nodes.label: Core Library README
nodes.rationale: Documents the shared core library that runs identically on server and client (wasm32), ensuring parity by construction. Covers document parsing, YAML subset, dates, filter DSL, and splices.
